landing.title: Your Real Office, Anywhere.
landing.subtitle: A complete digital headquarters for remote and hybrid teams — virtual offices, meetings, employee management, attendance, leave and collaboration in one place.
landing.chip: #1 Virtual Office Platform — Trusted by 10,000+ Teams
landing.hero_label: Live 3D Virtual Office — 23 employees online now
landing.trusted_by: Trusted by teams at the world's best companies
landing.feature1_subtitle: Hear as if you were there
landing.feature1_desc: Spatial audio technology makes conversations feel completely natural. The closer you get to a colleague in the virtual office, the clearer their voice becomes — just like in a real office. No meeting links or separate rooms needed.
landing.feature2_desc: Smart privacy zones that automatically disable camera and microphone. End-to-end encrypted communication bubbles that no one outside can hear or read. Enterprise-grade protection with SSO, SOC 2 & GDPR.
landing.feature3_desc: Meeting rooms with shared screens, interactive whiteboards, and workstations with built-in Pomodoro focus timers and smart task lists. Everything in one place without switching between apps.
landing.how_subtitle: No complex software to install. Open your browser and start working.
landing.step1_desc: Sign up and choose your office design from ready-made 3D templates or build it from scratch. Add desks, meeting rooms, and lounges.
landing.step2_title: Invite your team with one click
landing.step2_desc: Share a direct invitation link or send instant email invitations. Your team joins directly without any downloads.
landing.step3_desc: Move around the office, talk to colleagues with natural spatial audio, and use smart workstations.
landing.office_overview_title: A complete headquarters on your screen
landing.office_overview_desc: A fully interactive map — departments, meeting rooms, lounge and game areas, and smart facilities. Every element is interactive and customizable to suit your needs and team.
landing.security1_desc: All calls and messages are end-to-end encrypted with advanced WebRTC technology. No third party can access them.
landing.security2_desc: Integrate with Google Workspace, Microsoft Azure AD, or Okta for secure and seamless sign-in for all employees.
landing.security3_desc: We comply with the highest global data protection and privacy standards. Your data is securely stored in certified data centers.
landing.testimonial1_text: Kalspace completely changed how we communicate as a remote team. Spatial audio and private bubbles gave us a real sense of being together. Our productivity increased 40% in one month.
landing.testimonial2_text: The sensitive space privacy feature and interactive workstations made employees feel comfortable and productive. The best investment we made for remote work.
landing.testimonial3_text: Finally a platform that combines fun and serious work. Mini-games and the lounge area added soul to our team spread around the world.
landing.faq1_a: Yes! We offer a free plan for up to 10 users with all basic features. No credit card required to get started.
landing.faq2_a: The closer your character gets to a colleague on the office map, the clearer the sound between you becomes automatically and gradually. Move away and it decreases. Just like reality — no links or rooms needed.
landing.faq3_a: All calls and messages are encrypted with WebRTC end-to-end (E2E) technology. We comply with SOC 2 and GDPR standards to protect your organization's data.
landing.faq4_a: Completely! Build your office from scratch — add furniture, choose decor, assign departments, and customize every detail to suit your company culture.
landing.faq5_a: Works on all modern browsers without download. Also available as a desktop app for Windows and Mac. Mobile app is under development.
landing.cta_title: Ready to experience a virtual HQ that will wow your team?
landing.cta_desc: Join thousands of teams working with higher productivity and better communication. Free to start — no credit card required.
landing.footer_desc: The #1 platform for interactive virtual offices. Designed to make remote work more productive, human, and connected.

onboarding.disclaimer: Your space will be created immediately after sign in
